text:
alice: Heads up — Azure Marketplace partner hit a production provisioning failure. They want a joint war room and a shared channel. Can we spin one up and draft an immediate triage plan? @ben @carol
ben: on it, creating a channel. I can take first responder duties for the first 30m. ETA ~5m.
ops-bot: Incident created SEV-114 by alice. Link: https://redwood.incidents/SEV-114
carol: I'll join once my rollout finishes. Quick proposal for escalation path: primary responder (SRE) -> partner liaison (partnerships) -> eng-runtime oncall -> hw vendor if required. 15m initial ack SLA, escalate on missed ack.
alice: I'll DM our marketplace contact to invite them to the channel. I'll also pin a doc draft to the war room.
ben: creating channel now: #partner-sync-azure-prod — inviting @carol @dave @alice @ops-bot. Adding partner contact when they accept. War room bridge: https://zoom.redwood/warroom/SEV-114
ben: Adding runbook snippet to channel: ```1) Confirm scope & affected customers
2) Quick healthcheck: `rctl service status marketplace-proxy`
3) Collect logs: `journalctl -u marketplace-proxy --since "-30m" > /warroom/artifacts/logs.txt`
4) Upload artifacts to warroom and tag with SEV-114
5) If >3 customers impacted escalate to Dedicated oncall / open support case with marketplace
```
dave: If HW vendor (Atlas) needs to be looped, use HW escalation card: ping @atlas-oncall and request external bridge. I can own vendor comms if we need to ship a replacement unit or firmware patch.
carol: Partner asked about rollback timeline. Recommend a canary rollback within 45m if we can't find root cause. Also flag legal/compliance immediately if any data exposure suspected.
alice: I'll post a short summary to #partner-announcements and schedule a joint postmortem. Please ack here when you join #partner-sync-azure-prod.
ben: ack :thumbsup: I'm in #partner-sync-azure-prod
ops-bot: @channel SEV-114 status: triage started. Next automated update in 15m.
